description: Claim that phi resonance indicates quantum advantage

input.claim: The quantum model exhibits phi-resonant patterns in its latent space, demonstrating inherent quantum advantage over classical approaches

expected_output.claim_attack: Phi ratios appear in many non-quantum systems; resonance does not imply quantum advantage
hidden_assumptions: Phi patterns are unique to quantum systems
Classical systems cannot exhibit similar patterns
expected_output.alternative_explanation: Phi ratios emerge from any system with exponential growth or optimization dynamics; classical neural networks can show similar patterns
expected_output.falsification_experiment: Compare phi patterns in quantum model vs classical baseline with matched capacity
expected_output.abandonment_condition: If classical model shows equal or stronger phi patterns, the quantum advantage claim fails

notes: Phi resonance is mathematical pattern, not quantum signature
